bloques.pregunta: Cap. 2. What do you mean, «I'm not a doctor.»?

opciones.explicacion: «Не» goes in front of врач, the profession that refuses.
«Нет» can answer «No.» or indicate that there is nothing; here it is denied врач with не.
Place the emphasis on «Not me.»; to deny the profession, writes «Я не врач».
With я the first person is used: говорю.
It goes with он u она.
Age is formulated with «мне + número + лет»: literally, «to me, twenty years».
In Russian the age is expressed with «мне + años»; «у меня есть» is not used in this sentence.
"то" means «This / that»; it does not express possession.
Зовут is used with меня to say the name, not to express possession.
